source_differences: year: 1973 (list of tallest buildings) (en.wikipedia.org) against Year of completion: 1982 (page covers the high-rise and the square) (odprtehiseslovenije.org)

Height: the stored GURS height is 69.2 m. Inside the tower outline the laser scan surface has its middle at 68.2 m, 99 % of it stays below 72.1 m, and the highest pixel is at 77.2 m. Laser scanning of Slovenia (GURS, CLSS, file series NDMP), read 12 November 2026.
ZAG role: the ZAG pages say its researchers contributed content to the exhibition. They do not call ZAG a partner, and the involvement type "structural assessment" does not fit an exhibition.
